plain: A person who gives advice to a leader or an official

webster.text: One who gives advice or admonition; also, in a bad sense, one who instigates or persuades.

example.quote: Every thing, therefore, that the king does, must be by some advice, and the adviser of course answerable.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. IREDELL, July 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
